title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench: Testing the Limits of Agents on Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks with Dense Reward-Based Grading
abstract: arXiv:2607.08964v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI agents have become capable of autonomously completing short, well-specified tasks. However, existing terminal benchmarks largely focus on simple problems that finish within minutes and are evaluated only by their final outcome. This setup overlooks intermediate progress and partial solutions, yielding sparse reward signals and an incomplete picture of agent capability. We introduce Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench, a terminal benchmark of 46 long-horizon tasks spanning nine categories, including experiment reproduction, software engineering, multimodal analysis, interactive games, and scientific computing. Each task follows a Terminal-Bench-style setup with a reference solution or simulation engine, but is further decomposed into fine-grained graded subtasks. This design enables dense intermediate rewards and partial credit, allowing evaluation to capture not only whether an agent reaches the final goal, but also how far it progresses

translated_title: 长时程终端基准：通过密集奖励评分测试智能体在长时程终端任务上的极限
translated_abstract: AI智能体已经能够自主完成简短的、明确指定的任务。然而，现有的终端基准测试主要关注几分钟内即可完成的简单问题，且仅根据最终结果进行评估。这种设置忽略了中间进展和部分解决方案，导致奖励信号稀疏，无法完整反映智能体的能力。我们提出了Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench，这是一个包含46个长时程任务的终端基准，涵盖九个类别，包括实验复现、软件工程、多模态分析、交互式游戏和科学计算。每个任务遵循Terminal-Bench风格的设置，配有参考解决方案或模拟引擎，但被进一步分解为细粒度的分级子任务。这一设计实现了密集的中间奖励和部分得分，使评估不仅能捕捉智能体是否达成最终目标，还能衡量其进展程度。
tldr: 该论文提出了Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench基准，通过将46个长时程终端任务分解为细粒度的分级子任务并提供密集的中间奖励与部分得分，从而更全面地评估智能体在长时程任务中的能力进展。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench, a benchmark of 46 long-horizon terminal tasks decomposed into fine-grained graded subtasks with dense intermediate rewards and partial credit, enabling more comprehensive evaluation of agent progress beyond final outcomes.
